overview: France is a major country in Western Europe known for art, food, fashion, and fast trains.
climate: Much of France has mild seasons, while the south is warmer near the Mediterranean.
bestSeason: Late spring and early autumn are comfortable for families.
travelTips: Metro and train maps are easy to follow in big cities.
